correctness.rationale: Regular root 24-cell is C=conv{±e_i±e_j}=[-1,1]^4 intersect l1-ball radius 2, with 24 octahedral facets, each 3-volume 4/3, supporting distance 1, hence 4-volume 8. For five roots, D²=5 det scatter matrix, trace<=10, AM-GM yields |D|<=25sqrt(5)/4<14. D4 even-coordinate-sum lattice forces even integer D, thus |D|<=12. Explicit five-root witness determinant 12 gives maximum simplex volume=12/24=1/2, ratio 1/16; multilinear replacement extends upper bound to arbitrary points of C. Independently EXACT-enumerated all C(24,5)=42504 distinct root five-sets, determinant count {0:12168,2:11328,4:13776,6:3936,8:1152,10:96,12:48}, with zero repeated four-root faces among 48 top sets. A nonvertex optimum would interpolate two maximizers sharing four root vertices; impossible. Inspected full supplied script: it computes B4 signed-permutation orbit 48 and edge spectrum six lengths²=4/four lengths²=6. Census exactly exhausts finite root sets; continuum rigidity is separate analytic reasoning.
